settings.label: Board address
settings.help: What users type to reach this board - bbs.example.net, or an IP. Blank falls back to BBS_IP, then to the machine's own address, which inside a container is a private one nobody can dial.

settings.label: Nodes shown
settings.help: How many node lines the login screen lists. AmiExpress allows at most 32 (axconsts.e:43); this board's bbsConfig says MAX_NODES.
